photo: A real architectural interior photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24 mm lens at eye height, verticals straight, natural perspective. Material, light and detail as in a top architecture magazine: real thickness, real gloss, real texture. Clean and quiet, one clear subject. No people, no text, no signage, no logos, no watermark, no famous landmarks.
same: The same place, the same moment and the same light: every material, piece of furniture, plant and fitting stays exactly as it is. Only the camera has moved.
move: One continuous, smooth, steady gimbal shot at an unhurried walking pace, at a constant eye height of 1.5 metres. Only the camera moves: nothing in the place moves, opens, closes, slides, grows or changes. No cuts, no people, no text.
negative: warping, morphing walls, melting furniture, objects changing shape, objects appearing or vanishing, doors opening or closing by themselves, moving clouds, flicker, people, text, watermark, fast motion, shaky camera, fisheye
